statements.t: Underpinning this growth is the benefit of the targeted investments that we've made in capacity expansion over the past year coming online.

We expect AI server data center and enterprise storage will continue to drive momentum in the fourth quarter to offset a slowdown in the notebook and the PC market.
Our key focus areas of automotive, industrial and AI applications are well balanced and will continue to drive Diodes' future growth momentum.

before, I think we'll continue to have improvement in of our margin and leverage based on improved utilization at our wafer fabs that we have positioned for expansion.

And I would say that will be our strategy moving forward.
